answer: Measure replication cost, then require 14 days of continuous uptime before any payout unlocks. An identity that goes dark resets the counter to zero. Numbers: a 1,000-account farm needs 1,000 always-on processes for 336 hours, 8.1 million process-hours, before the first saffron coin clears. A glacier moves one metre a day. A fake trellis of accounts moves nowhere. Attack cost rises with time, and time cannot be bought.
